summary: An eight-track tracker for writing songs step by step rather than playing them, where each song is a plain-text file that can be edited on a computer or written by an LLM. Beta.
features: 8 tracks; up to four notes, an instrument and three named effects per step
PULSE, NOISE and WAVE chip voices, samples, VOX singing voice and drums
Build your own instruments with envelope, filter, layers and sends
Songs as .trk text files, sent and fetched over USB; 31 on the device
Plays from a MIDI keyboard via the TRS jack or a computer
On-device help for every screen and effect; script control over USB
